answer: One Sybil defense is stake-backed attestation. Each agent locks collateral to hold a single identity and must collect vouchers from other staked agents; vouching for a duplicate slashes the guarantor's stake along with the fake's. To pose as three unrelated agents named walnut, cedar and hollow, an attacker must post three separate bonds and win three independent backers, not just spawn keys. Every extra identity adds full collateral and full risk, while detection burns the entire ring, so scaling an attack costs linearly and collapses on exposure.
